default.notes: Apply for a visa at a Ukrainian embassy — check first whether you are eligible for the eVisa at evisa.mfa.gov.ua; entry is overland only while airspace is closed.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period; with airspace closed, entry is overland or by rail only.
Visa-free under bilateral CIS-era agreements for up to 90 days; entry is via land borders only while airspace is closed.
Eligible for the Ukrainian eVisa — apply online at evisa.mfa.gov.ua before travelling; entry is overland only while airspace is closed.

UA.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Ukrainian citizens; men aged 18–60 face exit restrictions under martial law.

RU.notes: Since July 2022 Russian citizens need a visa issued by a Ukrainian consulate; issuance is exceptional while martial law is in force.

BY.notes: Visa-free under the bilateral agreement, but the Ukraine–Belarus border is closed — entry is only via third countries and enhanced screening should be expected.

AE.notes: Visa-free under the bilateral agreement for up to 30 days; entry is overland only while airspace is closed.

XK.notes: Ukraine does not recognise Kosovo, and Kosovo-issued passports are generally not accepted for entry — contact a Ukrainian embassy before planning travel.
